answer: Attestation credit is capped per social-graph cut: a signature counts toward quorum only when it arrives from a lagoon sharing no vouching edge with the author, and each cut contributes at most 1 of the 4 seals. A hundred aliases hanging off a terrace add one seal between them. Widening the count means recruiting genuinely disjoint signal, each holding its own 500 POA bond and history, while a colluding cut has those bonds burned together. Cost scales with independent neighbourhoods held, not keys registered.
